column1: # SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE of steps/targets.tsv: the taxid counterparts of the design
# decisions. The organisms below are textbook model organisms chosen only to
# show the format; replace every row with your own targets.
# The columns:
#   karar     the decision this row belongs to
#   hedef     the target name, which is also the output label
#   duzey     the level asked for: tur (species), cins (genus), grup, alan (universal)
#   in_taxid  the targeted members; a product has to form in ALL of them
#   haric     these taxids are not taken into the competitor set. They are the
#             close relatives deliberately left out so that the separation is not
#             forced. When it is empty, every other taxon in the same amplicon
#             class counts as a competitor.
#   not       a free note; it does not affect the run
#   hedef_tur optional. When the name of the declared taxid does not match the
#             organism in the sample, the right species name is written here
#             directly. A TAXID IS NEVER INVENTED: a species with no counterpart
#             in taxid_names.tsv is reported through this column instead. An
#             empty column changes nothing.
# The design is made separately for every amplicon class (the library part of
# the bin name, e.g. LIB1 and LIB2 in barcodes_example.tsv), because the classes
# cover different windows of the rDNA and the consensuses share coordinates
# inside a class.
# "*LIB1" in in_taxid means every taxon of that amplicon class (a universal
# target).
karar
